lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水都亮一下。
lines.en: The water brightens wherever I swim.

lines.zh: 我身上七种颜色，游起来更乱。
lines.en: Seven colors on me, and swimming makes them blur.

lines.zh: 一群同伴挤着，我跟着走。
lines.en: A school presses together; I follow along.
I bend my tail into a small arc.

lines.zh: 浅水暖，我贴着沙慢慢游。
lines.en: The shallows are warm; I cruise just above sand.

lines.zh: 我的颜色随光变，很麻烦。
lines.en: My colors shift with the light — quite a nuisance.

lines.zh: 前面那片珊瑚，我穿过去。
lines.en: I slip through that patch of coral ahead.
I swim fast but keep bumping into kin.

lines.zh: 阳光从水面斜下来，我追它。
lines.en: Sunlight slants through the surface; I chase it.
One lap from me, and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 这条河不深，我的背都露着。
lines.en: This river is shallow; my back shows above it.

lines.zh: 我带着一队鱼往上游去。
lines.en: I lead a line of fish up the current.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我们全往旁边闪。
lines.en: At one splash we all dart sideways.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，不想太惹眼。
lines.en: I move my tail slowly, trying not to stand out.
I slip out from between the weeds.

lines.zh: 同伴的尾巴扫过我的脸。
lines.en: A companion's tail brushes my face.
I idle beside the water weeds.

lines.zh: 我的橙色在阴影里变暗。
lines.en: My orange darkens inside the shade.
A school of fish circles around me.

lines.zh: 我身上像有条彩虹卡住了。
lines.en: It feels like a rainbow is stuck on my scales.
The water is clear enough to see the bottom.

lines.zh: 我吐一个泡，跟着它往上。
lines.en: I make one bubble and follow it upward.
Four hit points vanish at a single touch.
I make no noise; only my colors are loud.

lines.zh: 水底的石头被晒得发暖。
lines.en: The stones below have been warmed by the sun.

lines.zh: 头顶过去的影子，我一个个数。
lines.en: I tally every shadow that crosses above me.
I fold my fins and rest a while.

lines.zh: 谁在水面丢了一片叶子。
lines.en: Someone dropped a leaf on the surface.

lines.zh: 这条河里的鱼都认得我。
lines.en: Every fish in this river knows me.
I wait for the light to turn before moving.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，颜色只有一种。
lines.en: You stand on the bank with only one color.
You look down at me and the reflection breaks.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水里被折成两截。
lines.en: The waterline splits your reflection cleanly.

lines.zh: 你手里那块东西晃我的眼。
lines.en: That thing in your hand keeps flashing at me.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，可我的鳍不敢近。
lines.en: I do not fear you, yet I keep my fins back.
You crouch, and your shadow lengthens.

lines.zh: 你想数我身上几种颜色吗？
lines.en: Do you want to count my colors?

lines.zh: 你眼睛跟着我转，我累了。
lines.en: Your eyes follow me; I am getting tired.
There is weed stuck to the edge of your boot.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我鳞片又没歪。
lines.en: What are you laughing at? My scales are fine.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我的颜色全白了。
lines.en: One hit and all my colors went white.

lines.zh: 我往草里钻，尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: I dive into the weeds, tail still trembling.
Scales drift in the water like broken light.
It hurts; I swim in crooked lines.
Who hit me? I was doing nothing.
I dare not stop; I keep darting forward.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从队伍里打散了。
lines.en: That knocked me out of the school.

lines.zh: 我的鳍垂下来，划不动水。
lines.en: My fin droops and cannot push water.
My colors are all over the water.

lines.zh: 我又躲回那块石头下面。
lines.en: I hide under that stone again.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我闻着香。
lines.en: What you dropped smells good to me.
I come to the surface to see it float.
So bright — is it food?
One nibble, and I spit the taste away.
The others crowd in; I cannot get through.
Your hand dips, and I am gone.
This is not enough to share with the school.
I circle twice and watch the others eat.
The good-smelling things are always on hooks.
Move back, and then I will rise.
You stepped into the water and knocked me aside.
The bump smeared all my colors.

lines.zh: 一群鱼撞在一起，乱成团。
lines.en: The school crashed together into a knot.

lines.zh: 我转了两圈才找回方向。
lines.en: I spun twice before finding my way.
Not the bucket; its sides are too hard.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的小腿滑过去。
lines.en: I slid past your calf.
That knock cost me a few scales.
The water is muddy; I cannot see the weeds.
Make room; I need to get through.
After the bump I hide behind a stone.
The blue on them is deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并着游，鳞片一闪一闪。
lines.en: We swim side by side, scales flashing.
Eggs cling in strings along the riverbed.
I circle them at my brightest.
They chose that flat stone.
We do not speak; we only read colors.

lines.zh: 水草边上，我们停了一会儿。
lines.en: We paused a moment by the water weeds.

lines.zh: 这么多卵，河要装不下了。
lines.en: So many eggs — the river will not hold them.

lines.zh: 它游远了，颜色还留在眼里。
lines.en: They swam off, but the color stays in my eyes.
Next year this river will be busier.
I pick up a bright fallen scale.

lines.zh: 你的东西沉下来，我顶了一下。
lines.en: Your thing sank; I nudged it.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着石子游不动。
lines.en: A stone in my mouth slows my swimming.
This thing is the same color as me.
I push it back toward the bank.
A school gathers around it to look.
Too slippery; it fell from my mouth.
It flashed, and I took it for kin.
I hide it inside the coral hole.
If you want it, I will push it over.
The surface stirs, and I look that way.

lines.zh: 那道黑影不小，我记住它。
lines.en: That dark shape is big; I will remember it.
I scatter the school first.
The way out is under that stone.
It is coming straight for the school.
I fix on its mouth.
I will not meet it; I will draw it off.
The danger is sliding along the bottom.
On three I dive.

lines.zh: 队伍里最亮的是我，糟了。
lines.en: I am the brightest in the school — bad.
It circles us, round and round.
My colors pull into a single line.
Whenever it nears, I change direction.
The school presses close to me.
The shadow on the surface is far too tall.

lines.zh: 我盯着那只伸下来的手。
lines.en: I watch the hand reaching down.
It freezes, and I freeze with it.
The weeds are swaying; it pushed them.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绷紧，随时能窜。
lines.en: My tail is taut, ready to bolt.
It backed off, and I am still watching.

lines.zh: 我撞它一下，只撞出个泡。
lines.en: I ram it once and only make a bubble.
Caught, I thrash my tail with all my strength.
I bite its barbel and will not let go.

lines.zh: 这一下是我能出的全部力气。
lines.en: This is all the force I have.

lines.zh: 我的鳍划破了水，也划破了它。
lines.en: My fin cut the water and cut it too.
Do not squeeze me; my scales come off.
I struck and was thrown back instead.
It let go, and I darted off at once.
All the colors on me have gone wild.
If I cannot win, I go into the rocks.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里出现，水花很小。
lines.en: I appear in the shallows with barely a splash.

lines.zh: 这条河的暖水正适合我。
lines.en: This river's warm water suits me.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是彩虹。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a rainbow.
Several colored shapes swim over to inspect me.
My colors are still faint.

lines.zh: 我在两根水草间动起来。
lines.en: I start moving between two water weeds.

lines.zh: 头顶有光在晃，我追上去。
lines.en: Light wavers overhead; I swim up to it.
Several fish on the bottom are watching me.
On my first day I know only stones.

lines.zh: 这条河记下了我的颜色。
lines.en: The river has taken down my colors.

lines.zh: 水被烧热，我的鳞片发白。
lines.en: The water boils hot and my scales turn white.

lines.zh: 我被抛上半空，又摔回水里。
lines.en: I am thrown into the air and crash back into the water.
The water is too thick; my gills are full of mud.

lines.zh: 轰响把整条河震得翻过来。
lines.en: The blast turned the whole river over.

lines.zh: 一道尖东西从岸上射进来。
lines.en: Something sharp shot in from the bank.

lines.zh: 咒光罩住我，动静都慢了。
lines.en: A spell light covers me and everything slows.

lines.zh: 找不到吃的，我颜色都淡了。
lines.en: With nothing to eat, my colors have faded.

lines.zh: 雷电打到河里，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the river; my whole body numbs.

lines.zh: 水退光了，我在空中乱摆。
lines.en: The water drained away; I thrash in the air.
